member.summary:
(Pro Version only)
Imports the GameDB from a server. Can be used in conjuction with the Golang server provided in the (Pro version) This allows over the air updating of GameDBs so new data can be pushed to clients without the need of releasing new versions of the clients. Downloaded GameDBs will be cached locally to avoid downloading again if they haven't changed. If they have change, only the diff between the original built-in GameDB and the uploaded GameDB will be downloaded.
member.param: The server host base address of the GameDB server to communicate with. For example: https://mygamedbserver.com
The download host base address of the GameDB to download. For example https://s3.aws.com/mygamedb
A unique identified used to represent the client downloading the GameDB. Can be used for A/B testing GameDB versions
The tag used to download the correct version of the GameDB
The original json the update is based off. This will be imported if there are no cached version or anything to download from the server
The path to cache downloaded GameDBs too
if set to true the GameDB will be loaded as a binary source (defaults to false) (key and salt required if loading binary)
the key used to encrypt the database via the utilities. Required if using binary = true
the salt used to encrypt the database via the utilities. Required if using binary = true
An array of field names to import.
A callback called when the data has be imported.
member.returns: A used to montior the request to the server.
